title: OrganizationalUnit
description: A unit of organisation (team, division, business unit, governance body, virtual team) that owns capabilities, runs processes, and is custodian for business objects. Classified by structural type, vertical scope, and ECF coordinates. Members (actors) and served stakeholders are referenced from typed catalogs. Catalog: technehub-labs/dea-catalog-organizational-units.

external_references.description: CR-3P: identifiers in external systems. Never a substitute for the OpenDEA id (E004).

ou_type.description: Structural kind of unit. 'business-unit' is a P&L-bearing organisational entity; 'division' is a top-level grouping under the enterprise; 'department' is a function-aligned grouping; 'team' is a stable working group; 'role-cluster' is a group defined by shared role rather than hierarchy; 'virtual-team' crosses formal boundaries for a specific purpose; 'governance-body' is a decision-making forum (committee, board, council); 'external-partner-role' is an external party acting as a unit (e.g. outsourced operations partner).

ou_scope.description: Vertical span — the breadth of the organisation this unit reaches. 'ecosystem' spans partner / supplier / customer networks; 'enterprise' is the full organisation; lower values are nested internal scopes.

ou_lifecycle.description: Formality and time horizon. 'permanent' is a stable org structure; 'temporary' has a defined end (project, programme); 'ad-hoc' is informal and may dissolve; 'sunsetting' is being decommissioned.

ecf_domain.description: The Enterprise Concept Framework domain this unit primarily serves. Optional — units that span domains (e.g. COO office) may leave this unset or set a 'multi' marker via tags.

ecf_stage.description: The lifecycle stage this unit primarily operates in. Optional.

head_count.description: Planned headcount. Snapshot — actual is derived from actors[].
